description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC Controller called OptionsValueController for managing product option values in an admin web interface, including listing, editing, creating, saving, deleting options and their images, and handling AJAX requests for pagination and removal.

classes.name: OptionsValueController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller for handling product option value management in the admin interface.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Handles GET request to display list of product options.

methods.name: displayOptionEdit
methods.description: Handles GET request to display an edit form for a specific option value.

methods.name: displayOption
methods.description: Prepares data for creating or editing an option value, including localizing descriptions.

methods.name: saveOption
methods.description: Validates and saves a product option value, including handling image uploads.

methods.name: pageOptions
methods.description: Handles AJAX POST request to retrieve a paginated list of options.

methods.name: deleteOptionValue
methods.description: Handles AJAX POST request to delete a specified option value.

methods.name: removeImage
methods.description: Handles AJAX POST request to remove an image associated with an option value.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets active menu items for the view.
